name: Revit IFC Check (exported IFC vs live model)
description: Read-only check of an IFC file written by revit_export against the live Revit model: which elements, classifications, materials, storeys and parameters the export dropped. ifc_only checks the file alone when Revit is not running. Not yet run against a live Revit.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Compare an exported IFC with the live Revit model and list what the export dropped: elements per category, classification (NL/SfB, Assembly Code), materials, storey assignment, expected parameters, duplicates at one placement, and the origin offset against the survey point. Read-only, no plan needed. Run it after revit_export with format ifc; use the revit_check_* tools for problems inside the model itself. The verdict is PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIED (never PASS when the model side was cut short or the file could not be read).

path.description: The .ifc file to check, inside the allowed workspace directories (usually the path you gave revit_export). The plans and proofs folders are refused.

categories.description: Revit categories to compare, for example ["Walls","Doors"] or OST_ names. Default: the usual building categories (walls, floors, roofs, doors, windows, columns, framing, ceilings, stairs, railings, generic models, curtain panels and mullions, furniture, pipes, ducts, MEP equipment).

ids.description: Compare only these Revit ElementIds (integers). Overrides categories.

tag.description: Compare only elements whose Comments parameter starts with this text.

level.description: Compare only elements on the level with this exact name.

expect_parameters.description: Parameter names that must reach the IFC as a property with the same name and value (any property set), for example ["FireRating","IsExternal"]. At most 30.

max_elements.description: Most Revit elements to read (default 2000, at most 20000). When there are more the result is truncated and the verdict cannot be PASS.

time_budget_s.description: Seconds the Revit side may spend reading elements (default 15, 1 to 120). When it runs out the result is partial and the verdict cannot be PASS.

ifc_only.description: Check only the IFC file (storeys, classes, property sets, classification, materials, storey assignment, duplicates, origin) without asking Revit. Use when Revit is not running; the result lists what it could not check.

limit.description: Most problem rows to return (default 50, at most 500). The full list goes to a detail file when it is longer.

offset.description: Skip this many problem rows first, to read the next page.

count_only.description: Return only the summary, verdict and counts (no rows).

fields.description: Row fields to keep (for example ["id","problem"]); omit for all fields.
